Technical specifications

Technical specifications — YL12200 · YL24200
Chemistry Lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4)
Nominal voltages 12.8 V and 25.6 V
Capacities 50, 100, 150 and 200 Ah depending on reference
Energy 0.64 to 5.12 kWh depending on reference
Charge voltage 14.4 – 14.8 V (12 V) · 28.8 – 29.6 V (24 V)
Charge method CC-CV — 0.2C to 14.4 V, then tapering to 0.02C
Cycle life ≥ 3,500 cycles @ 25 °C (0.2C, 80% DoD)
Design life ≥ 10 years
Monthly self-discharge ≤ 2% @ 35 °C
Charge and discharge efficiency ≥ 99% @ 0.2C
Internal resistance ≤ 60 to 80 mΩ depending on reference
Charging temperature 0 to 55 °C
Discharging temperature −20 to 60 °C
Storage temperature −10 to 45 °C
Case ABS
Terminals M6
Dimensions from 229 × 138 × 208 mm to 522 × 268 × 252 mm depending on reference
